PKGE.name: Transport Fare Or Parking Fee Unattended Payment Exemption
PKGE.definition: Payment is processed in a environment where strong customer authentication is inappropriate.

TMBE.name: Trusted Merchant Beneficiary Exemption
TMBE.definition: Cardholder has enrolled the Card Acceptor in the exemption list of strong customer authentication.

RECP.name: Recurring Payment
RECP.definition: Transaction is one of a series of recurring payment.

LOWA.name: Low Amount Exemption
LOWA.definition: Transaction's amount is low and could be processed without strong customer authentication.

SCPE.name: Secure Corporate Payment Exemption
SCPE.definition: Transaction is a secure corporate payment.

TRAE.name: Transaction Risk Analysis Exemption
TRAE.definition: According to the transaction risk analysis the strong customer authentication is not mandated.

CTLS.name: Contactless Exemption
CTLS.definition: Contactless payment at point of sale exemption.

TRSP.name: Transfer Same Person Exemption
TRSP.definition: Credit transfer between accounts held by the same natural or legal person exemption.
